title: The giant on the barn wall
_map: Shadows (stretch, usually Y3). Big idea: light travels in straight lines; shadows form where it's blocked. Creative: make the biggest and smallest shadow of Steve by moving the lamp.
_story: Steve sees a giant shape on the barn wall and gets scared. It's only his shadow. Ismaeel moves the lamp to make the shadow huge and tiny.
_stepChain: light travels in straight lines (disco: reflect) → Steve blocks some light → the dark shape behind it is a shadow → move the lamp closer: bigger shadow → further: smaller → Steve thinks moving further makes it bigger

talk.goodAnswer: something blocks the light, and light can't bend round it, so there's a dark shape behind.

talk.ask: How do you make a shadow bigger?
talk.goodAnswer: move the light closer to the object.

handsOn: In a dark room, shine a torch at your hand in front of a wall. Move the torch closer, then further. Make a shadow puppet of an animal!

narration.speaker: steve
narration.text: Aaah! Help! There's a giant dark shape on the barn wall! Oh. Wait. It moves when I move. I wave, it waves. Is that me?

Light zooms in straight lines, and it can't bend round corners. Steve gets in the way of some of the lamp's light. So behind Steve, there's a dark patch, the same shape as Steve! That dark patch is called a shadow.
Now let's move the lamp closer to Steve!

question.prompt: What will happen to the shadow?
question.reveal: Bigger! Whoa! The lamp is close, so Steve blocks a really wide fan of light.

narration.speaker: steve
narration.text: I want a teeny tiny shadow. So I'll move the lamp closer still!

question.prompt: How do you make the shadow smaller?
question.onRight: Yes! Move the lamp further away, and the shadow shrinks!

0.mistake: mixed up which way makes the shadow smaller
0.hint: When the lamp came closer, did the shadow grow or shrink?
0.say: Moving the lamp closer made the shadow bigger! To shrink it, move the lamp further away.

question.reveal: Far lamp, small shadow. Close lamp, giant shadow!

rule.text: Blocked light makes a shadow. Closer light, bigger shadow.
rule.ask: How is a shadow made? How do you make it bigger? Say it out loud! Then tap the eye.
rule.spoken: Light travels in straight lines. When something blocks it, there's a shadow behind. Move the light closer, and the shadow gets bigger.

bonus.prompt: Bonus! When is your shadow longest, outside?
bonus.reveal: Early in the morning, or in the evening, when the sun is low in the sky! At lunchtime, it's short.
